# Reproducible research fixture

This tiny project measures the mean of three values in `observations.csv`.
The expected mean is **4.0**. The demo works on a private copy of this tree.

Run `python3 analysis.py` to print the mean. No external Python packages needed.

The mock agent will inspect/search the project, edit a report, run the analysis,
inspect/stop a background job, fetch a local page, load a skill, schedule/cancel
a timer, inspect an image, and ask one question before its Markdown report.

field.png is a deterministic 320×200 RGB grid with a circular reference.
Recreate it with `python3 make_image.py`; only the standard library is needed.
